blocks.text: Akari fended off a late PLDT rally and held Savi Davison to just five points to enter the win column of the 2026 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) All-Filipino Conference Siklab series, 25-18, 25-19, 25-22, on Tuesday at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City.
